scoring_justification: The checker recomputes ΔE from the agent's raw total energies and compares to the paper's reported values with tolerance ±0.4 eV; full recompute from raw artifact.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold energy differences for Zn-face and O-face ZnO, derived from the paper's reported minimum total energies.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figures 7 and discussion: N on Zn-face minimum = −21.65 eV, In on Zn-face minimum = −20.08 eV, N on O-face minimum = −21.75 eV, In on O-face minimum = −20.05 eV. Thus ΔE_Znface = −1.57 eV, ΔE_Oface = −1.70 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Computed as E(N) − E(In) from the paper's stated energies.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers reported by the paper; they represent the authoritative computational reference.

outputs.description: Minimum total energies in eV for N and In adatoms on Zn-face and O-face ZnO surfaces. The hidden checker recomputes the differences ΔE(Zn-face) = N_Znface – In_Znface and ΔE(O-face) = N_Oface – In_Oface, and compares them to hidden paper-derived reference values with tolerance.

output_contract.notes: Only the DFT calculation is reproduced; experimental MBE growth data are excluded. The original VASP code is replaced by Quantum ESPRESSO, so absolute total energies may differ, but relative adsorption energy differences are comparable within tolerance.
